notes: Single style on the page. Year = 1st-2nd numerical digits, month = 3rd-4th numerical digits (1-based), converted to 0-based half-open ranges. Serial is all digits, so character and digit counting agree. Page example 850304091 decodes to March 1985. No held styles on this page; page image is a date-of-manufacture diagram, not a decode chart. Parent chain per page: Consolidated Industries, whose assets were sold (1990s) to Texas Furnace, LLC, a subsidiary of AllStyle Coil Company, L.P. Kept separate from Sun Glow and Sunbelt. Sister list is page metadata only; no rule is imported from any sister page.
